register.labelZh: SCRAPE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: scrape by 可以表示某人的金錢只夠應付基本需要,幾乎沒有多餘的錢。；scrape in 和 scrape into 可以表示候選人僅以少量票數當選,或球隊僅僅成功晉級。；scrape off 用於刮走表面上的東西;scrape out 則用於刮出容器或物件內部的東西。；這些表達適合用來談論金錢、選舉、比賽、烹飪、清潔和簡單維修工作。
register.summaryEn: Scrape by describes a situation in which someone has just enough money for basic needs, but almost nothing extra. Scrape in and scrape into can describe a candidate winning by very few votes or a team only just reaching the next stage. Scrape off is used for something on a surface, while scrape out is used for something inside a container or object. These expressions are useful when talking about money, elections, competitions, cooking, cleaning and simple repair work.
